articles.title: Boomers punch ticket to 2027 World Cup as unbeaten run continues
articles.description: The Australian Boomers have qualified for the 2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup in Qatar following a dominant victory over Iran, extending their unbeaten run in the Asian Qualifiers to nine games. Rising star Max Mackinnon led the way with 30 points and eight three-pointers, while David Okwera and Jack White made valuable contributions. Australia remains atop Group E ahead of New Zealand, securing its 14th FIBA World Cup appearance with three qualifying games remaining. The Boomers will next face Jordan as preparations continue towards the 2027 World Cup in Doha and the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles, United States.

articles.title: One win from a World Cup: Inside unbeaten Boomers' brilliant campaign... and where it can take them
articles.description: The Australian Boomers are on the verge of qualifying for the 2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup in Qatar, with just one victory potentially securing their place in Doha. Australia enters the latest FIBA Asian Qualifiers window undefeated after eight games, with upcoming clashes against Iran and Jordan in Malaysia. Led by a talented squad featuring Sam Froling and Jack White, the Boomers will look to maintain their dominant qualifying campaign. We preview both fixtures, examine Australia's head-to-head records, highlight key opposition players and assess what lies ahead as the Boomers look to improve on their 10th-place finish at the 2023 tournament.
